title: canary release scratchpad - ashley morgan
content:
Quick scratchpad for the upcoming canary rollout (hosted API runtime v2.4.1 -> v2.5.0).

OBJECTIVE:
- Validate v2.5.0 in production with low blast radius. Check latency, errors, and output regressions on primary workloads (chat, streaming, embeddings).
- Confirm version-pinning behavior and fallback routing works for mixed-traffic customers.

SCOPE / WHAT'S IN: 
- Hosted API (api.redwood.ai) route /v1/generate and /v1/chat using model runtime v2.5.0.
- Canary target: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% (if stable).
- Customers: internal test orgs + subset of low-risk external customers (opt-in list).

WHAT'S OUT: 
- Dedicated clusters and Private deployments (separate schedule).
- Heavy-throughput customers (>2000 rps) until 50% step validated.

VERSION PINNING NOTES: 
- Ensure default routing behavior: if customer has pinned runtime=v2.4.x, requests must still hit that variant (no implicit upgrade). Confirm config fallback policy: pinned -> no change; unpinned -> follow SLO routing policy.
- Configs to double-check: rollout_policy.yaml (percentages, sticky-session TTL), fallback_table.json (compatible model variants).
- Migration task: add explicit migration flag in customer config to enable auto-upgrade (separate change).

CHECKLIST (pre-rollout) - MUST COMPLETE BEFORE ANY TRAFFIC SHIFT:
- [ ] Merge and smoke-run PR #789 in staging (runtime integration tests green).
- [ ] Create canary feature flag (feature/canary/v2.5.0) and gate in router.
- [ ] Update canary route in traffic-manager: add v2.5.0 with 1% weight.
- [ ] Add dashboards/tiles for v2.5.0: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, 5xx, 4xx, GPU mem OOMs, token throughput.
- [ ] Add synthetic canary tests (smoke prompts + eval set) to run every 5m against canary pool.
- [ ] Notify SRE, CS, Support, and PM (post Slack plan & escalation path).
- [ ] Backup config snapshots and save rollout_marker tag in infra repo.

ROLLOUT PLAN (detailed):
- Step 0 (0%): baseline collection for 24h on staging & production for v2.4.1 metrics.
- Step 1 (1%): 30m observe. If stable -> Step 2. If issues -> rollback to 0% and revert router entry.
- Step 2 (5%): 1h observe. Run full synthetic eval suite, manual sample of 50 chat responses for hallucination/regression.
- Step 3 (20%): 2h observe. Watch throughput-related metrics (batching, CPU/GPU_mig).
- Step 4 (50%): 4h observe. Start enabling small non-critical customers (remove opt-in).
- Step 5 (100%): finalize and mark release.

ROLLBACK CRITERIA (auto + manual):
- Auto rollback triggers:
  - error_rate (5xx) for canary > 2x baseline for 10m OR absolute 5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m.
  - p95 latency increase > 50% vs baseline for 10m.
  - GPU OOMs > 0 (any OOM during canary window).
  - synthetic eval fail rate > 5% relative delta in quality metrics.
- Manual rollback: on-call SRE or Release Lead can roll back for any qualitative regression flagged by CS/PM.

MONITORING / DASHBOARDS / ALERTS:
- Dashboards to use: Release > Canary v2.5.0 (tile ids: canary_latency_v2_5, canary_errors_v2_5, canary_smoke_eval_v2_5).
- Alerts to create/verify:
  - Alert A1: canary_5xx_rate_high -> trigger paging to SRE (threshold 0.5% sustained 5m).
  - Alert A2: p95_latency_increase -> SRE + Release Lead (delta 50% over baseline, 10m).
  - Alert A3: smoke_eval_fail -> PagerDuty to QA rotate.

SMOKE / QUALITY TESTS:
- Synthetic prompts: small chat prompts (5 categories), deterministic seed. Results saved to canary-evals bucket.
- Manual sampling: QA to review 50 responses at each major step (5% & 20%). Record any semantic regressions in the 'canary-regressions' doc.

COMMUNICATIONS & ESCALATION:
- Pre-rollout Slack post to #release-notifications and #sre 30m before Step 1.
- On-call SRE: Samir Patel (primary), backup: Noah Kim.
- Release Lead: Ashley Morgan (me). PM: Priya Kapoor.
- Support runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Release+Runbook

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (notes to self):
- Q1: Does routing sticky-sessions respect version pinning TTL of 24h? Need to verify with router team (Samir).
- Q2: Are we capturing token-level cost delta metrics for v2.5.0? Add metric if missing.
- Q3: Does fallback routing preserve streaming session state for chat sessions mid-stream? Risk for streaming clients.
- TODO: Ask infra to run a 1h soak with 20% synthetic traffic to surface memory leaks (ticket JIRA-ENG-2399).

POST-ROLLOUT:
- Collect 24h post-mortem metrics.
- If stable at 100% for 48h, tag runtime repo with release/v2.5.0 and update docations.
- Schedule post-release retro (30-60m) within 3 business days.

QUICK COMMANDS / LINKS:
- Router rollout API example: curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/rollouts -d '{"service":"hosted-api","variant":"v2.5.0","weight":1}' (ops only)
- Staging smoke PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789
- Jira epic: JIRA-ENG-2345 (canary rollout + version pinning)

NOTES / TIMESTAMPED LOG (quick):
- 2026-02-20: Started smoke runs in staging, slight increase in p95 on long context tests (investigating).
- 2026-02-24: Memory patch applied in PR #802, mitigated OOMs in staging.
- 2026-02-28: Final pre-rollout checks; dashboards ready.

PRIVACY / SECURITY REMINDERS:
- No production customer PII should be used in synthetic tests. Use redacted/synthetic data sets only.
- Ensure any logs used for debugging are retained per retention policy and redacted where necessary.

Random notes to self: keep checklist minimalist, don't over-automate rollback unless we have solid canary metrics. If any sticky-session issues, prefer manual cutover for affected customers.

-- ashley
